title: Solutions, Colloids and Suspensions
summary: Particle size decides everything: clear solutions, cloudy colloids that scatter light, and suspensions that settle.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 5: Exploring Mixtures and their Separation
Earlier NCERT: Is Matter Around Us Pure?

objectives: I can classify mixtures as solutions, colloids or suspensions.
I can explain the Tyndall effect.
I can name the dispersed phase and dispersion medium of common colloids.
misconceptions: Anything cloudy must be a suspension.
